paragraphs: In Arakhin 28b: Rav Chiyya bar Ami in the name of Cholfana; see also the entry Ulpana.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied title before Chiyya is abbreviated ר׳. The William Davidson digital text of Arakhin 28b fully writes Rav Chiyya bar Ami (רב חייא בר אמי), supporting Rav here.

The whole Davidson Arakhin 28b paragraph explicitly writes Rav Chiyya bar Ami in the name of Cholfana. The current note remains verbatim and the separate Ulpana pointer remains unbound. No surrounding ruling or additional figure is imported.
